{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, your promise to respond to accusations of corruption leveled against Senator Maxim&hellip;|Unidentified reporter to Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Maxim''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> he caused a minor scandal, resulting in charges of corruption to be made against him. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] did not intervene due to issues with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] arising from the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] and destroyed the ''[[Revenue]]''.<ref name="CoD" />
